data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin providing a performance-optimized signature canvas with custom styling and export.
data.what_it_does: Provides a signature canvas widget and a controller for capturing user signatures. Allows customizing stroke width, pen color, and background, as well as exporting the drawing to PNG or SVG bytes, or restoring from previously saved points.
use_when: You need users to draw signatures on screen in a Flutter application.
You need to export signatures as PNG or SVG images.
You need undo/redo functionality for canvas drawing.
avoid_when: You are building a complex freehand drawing or painting app requiring multi-layer support or brushes.
You do not need signature capture functionality.
strengths: Performance optimized for a wide range of devices.
Supports exporting drawings to PNG and SVG formats.
Includes built-in undo, redo, and initial state restoration.
weaknesses: Limited to single-layer signature input and basic canvas manipulation.
Requires manual wrapping in an Expanded widget inside flex layouts when used without explicit dimensions.
